item.title: PowerBar 0.8
item.description:
PowerBar 0.8

  • The Dashboard widget shows every new song's cover. From the third song on, it could show an earlier song's cover instead, which was easiest to see with PowerBar's window closed.
  • PowerBar updates the installed widget when 0.8 starts. If the widget is open in Dashboard at that moment, remove it and add it again (or log out and back in) to load the new version.
  • Opening a feature (such as Why This Song) right after cancelling another one no longer sometimes picks up the cancelled feature's question.

item.title: PowerBar 0.7
item.description:
PowerBar 0.7

  • PowerBar now updates itself. PowerBar › Check for Updates… looks for a new version, and PowerBar checks once a day by itself if you let it (it asks the second time you open it).
  • Updates come over modern, verified HTTPS and are signed: PowerBar checks each update's signature before installing it, and refuses anything that doesn't match.
  • After an update, an installed Dashboard widget is refreshed to the new version automatically.

Coming from 0.6? Install 0.7 by hand this once (0.6 can't update itself). From 0.7 on, new versions arrive by themselves.
